footer.zh: FiveM 画质包安装教程 · 中英双语 · 内容与媒体经 GitHub (jsdelivr CDN) 动态加载
footer.en: FiveM Graphics Pack Tutorial · Bilingual · Content & media loaded dynamically from GitHub (jsdelivr CDN)

p.zh: FiveM 是 GTA V 的大型多人联机模组平台。配合画质包（如 NVE、QuantV、ReShade 预设），可以让游戏画面焕然一新，甚至接近真实照片效果。本教程将带你从零开始完成安装。
p.en: FiveM is a large multiplayer mod platform for GTA V. With a graphics pack (such as NVE, QuantV or ReShade presets), the game can look brand new — even close to real photos. This tutorial walks you through everything from scratch.

note.zh: 准备工作：1. 正版 GTA V（Steam / Epic / Rockstar 均可；须安装 Legacy 版，见步骤 1 说明） 2. 建议显卡 GTX 1060 及以上 3. 至少 30GB 空闲磁盘空间 4. 稳定的网络。
note.en: Requirements: 1. A genuine copy of GTA V (Steam / Epic / Rockstar — you need the Legacy version, see Step 1) 2. Recommended GPU: GTX 1060 or better 3. At least 30GB of free disk space 4. A stable internet connection.

img.capZh: 图 1：安装 FiveM 的四个步骤
img.capEn: Fig 1: Four steps to install FiveM

zh: 打开官网 https://fivem.net，点击 Download 下载安装器。
运行 FiveM.exe，安装器会自动安装到C盘；然后会请手动选择 GTA 5 文件夹。（里面需要包含 GTAV.exe 文件）
等待 FiveM 完成基础安装（首次会下载一些必需文件）。
启动 FiveM，登录 Rockstar 账号，随便进入一个来自您自己的国家的没有白名单的服务器测试能否正常加入。
en: Open https://fivem.net and click Download to get the installer.
Run FiveM.exe; the installer will auto-install to the C: drive; then you'll be prompted to manually select the GTA 5 folder (which must contain the GTAV.exe file).
Wait for FiveM to finish its base installation (it downloads required files on first run).
Launch FiveM, log in with your Rockstar account, and join a random server in your country that doesn't have a whitelist to test.

note.zh: 重要：FiveM 现同时支持 GTA V 的 Legacy（传承版）与 Enhanced（增强版）（增强版客户端于 2026 年 7 月以早期访问形式上线，使用独立启动器，与传承版并行）。但不建议在增强版上使用本教程：早期访问阶段存在不稳定因素，画质模组暂不可用，社区生态也尚未成熟。请使用 Legacy（传承版）完成安装（Rockstar Launcher → 设置 → 安装 Grand Theft Auto V Legacy）。
note.en: Important: FiveM now supports both Legacy and Enhanced builds of GTA V (the Enhanced client launched in early access in July 2026 via a separate launcher, running alongside Legacy). However, we do not recommend following this tutorial on Enhanced: early access is unstable, graphic mods are not available yet, and the ecosystem is not mature. Please use the Legacy build (Rockstar Launcher → Settings → install Grand Theft Auto V Legacy).

note.zh: 安装完成后，桌面会出现 FiveM 图标。此时可以退出游戏，进入下一步。(如果不需要安装画质包，可跳过关闭所有步骤，直接进入游戏。)
note.en: A FiveM icon appears on your desktop afterwards. You may quit the game and continue to the next step. (If you don't need a graphics pack, you can skip all steps and go straight to the game.)

img.capZh: 图 2：常见画质包与下载方式
img.capEn: Fig 2: Popular packs and where to get them

h3.zh: 常见画质包推荐 / 使用对比

zh: NaturalVision Evolved (NVE)：业界公认最真实，需要 Patreon 付费支持作者；提供 FiveM 专用版。
QuantV：电影感色调，画面极具风格化。
ENB (ENBSeries)：可在 enbdev.com 免费下载，适合单机模式画面增强。
免费 ReShade 预设：GitHub 上有大量免费预设，适合新手尝试。
en: NaturalVision Evolved (NVE): widely regarded as the most realistic; supports the author via Patreon; has a FiveM-specific version.
QuantV: cinematic color grading with a highly stylized look.
ENB (ENBSeries): free download at enbdev.com — great for single-player visuals.
Free ReShade presets: plenty of free presets on GitHub — great for beginners.

note.zh: 下载后一般得到一个 zip 压缩包。请完整解压。
note.en: You usually get a zip archive. Extract it fully.

h2.zh: 步骤 3 · 把文件复制到 FiveM

img.capZh: 图 3：FiveM 目录结构（重点：data 文件夹）
img.capEn: Fig 3: FiveM folder structure (focus: the data folder)

h3.zh: 第 1 步：确认画质包的完整安装路径

zh: 画质包安装的完整路径就是 FiveM.app 文件夹：默认位置为 C:\Users\用户名\AppData\Local\FiveM\FiveM.app（即 %localappdata%\FiveM\FiveM.app）。
自定义位置则在例如 D:\FiveM_Legacy\FiveM.app。
画质包解压后的文件就安装进这个 FiveM.app 文件夹下对应的目录（具体放在哪见第 2 步）。
en: The full install path for a graphics pack is the FiveM.app folder: default is C:\Users\[YourName]\AppData\Local\FiveM\FiveM.app (same as %localappdata%\FiveM\FiveM.app).
For a custom install, e.g. D:\FiveM_Legacy\FiveM.app.
Extracted pack files are installed into the matching subfolders inside this FiveM.app (exact destinations in Step 2).

h3.zh: 第 2 步：把画质包文件复制进去
h3.en: Step 2: copy the pack files in

zh: 先把画质包 zip 完整解压，得到解压后的文件夹。
打开解压后的文件夹，按 Ctrl + A 全选里面的所有文件。
按 Ctrl + C 复制，然后进入 FiveM.app\data 文件夹。
在 data 文件夹内按 Ctrl + V 粘贴；如果提示“合并 / 替换”，选择“是”或“替换目标中的文件”。
（可选）删除 caches 缓存文件夹，让游戏重新生成缓存，可避免画质包冲突。
有些画质包（如 NVE）要求把文件放在 FiveM.app 根目录而不是 data，请以画质包自带说明为准。
en: First fully extract the pack's zip into a folder.
Open the extracted folder and press Ctrl + A to select everything.
Press Ctrl + C to copy, then go into the FiveM.app\data folder.
Press Ctrl + V inside data to paste; if asked about "Merge / Replace", choose "Yes" / "Replace files in the destination".
(Optional) Delete the caches folder so the game regenerates it — this avoids conflicts.
Some packs (e.g. NVE) require files in the FiveM.app root instead of data — always follow the pack's own instructions.

note.zh: 新版 FiveM 的 FiveM.app 里没有 GTA5.exe —— 游戏本体在 GTA V 安装目录（如 Steam 的 Grand Theft Auto V 文件夹）。另外，ReShade 的 dxgi.dll 不要放进 data，应放 FiveM.app\plugins（见步骤 4）。
note.en: The GTA5.exe is not inside FiveM.app anymore — the game lives in your GTA V install folder (e.g. Steam's Grand Theft Auto V). Also, do not put ReShade's dxgi.dll into data — it goes in FiveM.app\plugins (see Step 4).

h2.zh: 步骤 4 · 安装 ReShade + 视频教程

video.badgeZh: 视频来自 GitHub 托管（CDN 加载）
video.badgeEn: Video hosted on GitHub (served via CDN)
video.capZh: 视频：请将你的安装演示视频上传到 GitHub 的 assets/video/ 文件夹
video.capEn: Video: upload your demo video to assets/video/ in your GitHub repo

zh: 从 https://reshade.me 下载并运行 ReShade 安装器。
点击 Select game，选择 GTA V Legacy 版游戏目录里的 GTA5.exe（Steam 例：steamapps\common\Grand Theft Auto V\GTA5.exe）。不要选 FiveM.exe —— FiveM 会忽略其目录下的图形 DLL（控制台会提示 Ignored graphics mod）。
图形接口选择 DirectX 10/11/12。
勾选下载着色器（Standard effects 等），等待完成。
安装完成后打开 GTA V 目录，把生成的 dxgi.dll、ReShade.ini、ReShadePreset.ini、ReShade.log 和 reshade-shaders 文件夹剪切到 FiveM.app\plugins。
把画质包附带的 ReShade 预设（.ini）也复制到 FiveM.app\plugins。
en: Download and run the ReShade installer from https://reshade.me.

Click Select game and choose GTA5.exe in your GTA V Legacy folder (e.g. Steam: steamapps\common\Grand Theft Auto V\GTA5.exe). Do not pick FiveM.exe — FiveM ignores graphics DLLs in its own folder (the console will show "Ignored graphics mod").
Select DirectX 10/11/12 as the graphics API.
Tick the shaders to download (Standard effects, etc.) and wait for it to finish.
After installing, open the GTA V folder and cut the generated dxgi.dll, ReShade.ini, ReShadePreset.ini, ReShade.log and the reshade-shaders folder into FiveM.app\plugins.
Also copy the pack's ReShade preset (.ini) into FiveM.app\plugins.

note.zh: 安装器会把 dxgi.dll 等写入你选择的 GTA V 目录 —— 这一步不会动 FiveM。把它们移入 FiveM.app\plugins 后，FiveM 才会加载 ReShade。
note.en: The installer writes dxgi.dll etc. into the GTA V folder you picked — it does not touch FiveM. FiveM only loads ReShade after you move those files into FiveM.app\plugins.

h2.zh: 步骤 5 · 启动游戏并启用画质

zh: 通过 FiveM 启动器进入任意服务器。
游戏中按 Home 键 打开 ReShade 面板。
在面板顶部的下拉框中选择画质包预设，勾选需要的特效。
在游戏设置中开启 高级图形设置 → 超高，效果更佳。
en: Join any server through the FiveM launcher.
Press Home in-game to open the ReShade panel.
Pick your pack preset in the dropdown at the top and enable the effects you want.
In game settings, enable Advanced Graphics → Very High for the best look.

note.zh: 如果按 Home 没反应，说明 dxgi.dll 没放进 FiveM.app\plugins 或未在 CitizenFX.ini 放行，请回到步骤 4 检查。
note.en: If Home does nothing, dxgi.dll is not in FiveM.app\plugins or not approved in CitizenFX.ini — go back to Step 4.

h2.zh: 进阶 · RPF 文件与插件

sub.zh: RPF / ASI / ReShade Addon · 参考官方文档
sub.en: RPF / ASI / ReShade Addon · per official docs

p.zh: 如果你下载的画质包或模组附带 .rpf 文件、.asi 插件，或想给 ReShade 装 addon，本节告诉你正确的位置（内容参考 FiveM 官方 Client Manual 与 ReShade 官方文档）。
p.en: If your pack or mod ships with .rpf files, .asi plugins, or you want to install ReShade add-ons, this section shows where things go (based on the official FiveM Client Manual and ReShade docs).

h3.zh: RPF 文件：联机由服务器管理，客户端不加载
h3.en: RPF files: managed by servers — the client does not load them

zh: FiveM 联机时，游戏模型 / 地图等 RPF 内容由服务器端资源（stream 文件夹）统一下发，玩家把 .rpf 放进本地 FiveM 目录不会被加载。
官方 Client Manual 只说明客户端支持 plugins 文件夹放置 .asi 脚本，没有客户端安装 RPF 的入口。
单机 GTA V 使用 RPF 模组：用 OpenIV 导入到 GTA V 游戏目录（如 update\x64\dlcpacks 并在 dlclist.xml 注册，或用 mods 文件夹方案）；OpenIV 属于社区工具，操作前建议备份原文件。
en: In FiveM multiplayer, RPF content (models, maps) is streamed by the server — putting .rpf files into your local FiveM folder will not load them.
The official Client Manual only documents a plugins folder for .asi scripts on the client; there is no client-side RPF install path.
For single-player GTA V RPF mods: import them with OpenIV (e.g. into update\x64\dlcpacks + register in dlclist.xml, or use the mods folder). OpenIV is a community tool — back up your files first.

h3.zh: ASI 插件：放在 FiveM 的 plugins 文件夹（官方支持）
h3.en: ASI plugins: the FiveM plugins folder (officially supported)

zh: 打开 %localappdata%，进入 FiveM → FiveM.app（或你的自定义位置，如 D:\FiveM_Legacy\FiveM.app）。
新版 FiveM 的 FiveM.app 已自带 plugins 文件夹；若你的版本里没有，手动创建一个（右键 → 新建 → 文件夹，命名为 plugins）。
把 .asi 插件文件放进去，重启 FiveM 生效。
en: Open %localappdata% and go to FiveM → FiveM.app (or your custom path like D:\FiveM_Legacy\FiveM.app).
Modern FiveM ships with a plugins folder inside FiveM.app; if yours is missing, create one manually (right-click → New → Folder named plugins).
Drop your .asi plugin in there and restart FiveM.

note.zh: 官方提醒：服务器可以禁用插件；部分插件过时或与 FiveM 不兼容可能导致闪退，且官方不提供插件支持，使用风险自担。
note.en: Official note: servers may disallow plugins; outdated or incompatible plugins can crash the game, and the client provides no support — use at your own risk.

h3.zh: mods 文件夹：单机 RPF 文件的去处（需手动创建）
h3.en: mods folder: where single-player RPF files go (create it yourself)

p.zh: GTA V 单机（非 FiveM）默认没有 mods 文件夹，需要手动创建；.rpf 文件放这里，不会破坏游戏原文件。FiveM 联机时 mods 文件夹不起作用。
p.en: Single-player GTA V has no mods folder by default — create it manually; .rpf files go here without touching original game files. The mods folder has no effect in FiveM multiplayer.

zh: 在 GTA V 游戏根目录（例如 D:\SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\GTA V）右键 → 新建文件夹，命名为 mods。
（推荐）打开 OpenIV → Tools → Package Installer / Mods 模式，生成与游戏一致的 mods 目录结构。
把画质包或模组解压得到的 .rpf 文件（以及需要的 dlclist.xml 配置）放进 mods 对应位置。
en: In the GTA V game root (e.g. D:\SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\GTA V) right-click → New → Folder, named mods.
(Recommended) Open OpenIV → Tools → enable Mods mode / Package Installer so it builds the correct mods structure for you.
Put the .rpf files (and any dlclist.xml changes) from your extracted mod into the matching mods location.

h3.zh: ReShade Addon：addon 文件从哪获取 + 允许配置怎么写
h3.en: ReShade Add-ons: where to get .addon files + how to fill in the config

zh: 在 reshade.me 主页下载 ReShade with full add-on support（未签名版本，安装器界面颜色与标准版不同）；签名版不会加载任何 addon。
获取 addon 文件：.addon 是作者编译好的成品，无需自己写代码——从作者的发布页下载（如 GitHub Releases、作者主页），例如 ReShade 官方论坛 Addons 版块或知名预设作者的下载页。
把下载的 .addon 文件放入 addon 搜索目录：默认就是 ReShade 所在目录（即 FiveM.app\plugins，和 dxgi.dll 放一起）。注意：64 位游戏（FiveM 就是）用 .addon64，32 位游戏用 .addon32。
填写允许配置：安装 addon 版后 ReShade.ini 通常已自动生成 [ADDON] 段；也可以在游戏内 ReShade 面板的 Add-ons 页面顶部修改搜索路径，或手动编辑（见下方代码块）。
重启游戏，ReShade 日志（ReShade.log）出现 Searching for add-ons (*.addon) 和 Registered add-on 即表示加载成功。
en: Download ReShade with full add-on support from reshade.me (the unsigned build — its installer UI is color-coded differently); the signed build loads no add-ons at all.

Getting add-on files: a .addon file is a pre-built binary — you don't write any code. Download it from the author's release page (e.g. GitHub Releases, the author's site, or the Add-ons section of the official ReShade forum).

Put the .addon file into the add-on search directory: by default that is ReShade's own folder (FiveM.app\plugins, next to dxgi.dll). Note: 64-bit games (like FiveM) use .addon64, 32-bit games use .addon32.

Filling in the config: the add-on build usually creates the [ADDON] section in ReShade.ini automatically; you can also change the search path at the top of the Add-ons page in the in-game overlay, or edit it manually (see the code block below).
Restart the game. When ReShade.log shows Searching for add-ons (*.addon) and Registered add-on, the add-on loaded successfully.

note.zh: addon 版为未签名构建，反作弊或部分服务器可能将其视为作弊并封号；在联机服务器使用前请确认服务器规则，单机使用相对安全。
note.en: The add-on build is unsigned — anti-cheat and some servers may treat it as cheating and ban you. Check server rules before joining; it is relatively safe in single-player.

h3.zh: ReShade 装好却没反应？（F8 控制台 + CitizenFX.ini 放行）
h3.en: ReShade installed but nothing works? (F8 console + CitizenFX.ini approval)

p.zh: 有一种情况：ReShade 全部安装正确，但游戏里没有任何编译进度条、按 Home 也没反应。这是因为 FiveM 检测到 ReShade 的 DLL 后需要玩家在配置里手动放行。
p.en: Sometimes ReShade is fully installed but there is no shader compilation progress bar and Home does nothing. That is because FiveM detected the ReShade DLL and needs your manual approval in the config.

zh: 游戏内按 F8 打开 FiveM 控制台。
查看是否有类似 [Addons] ReShade5=ID:xxxxxxx acknowledged that ReShade 5.x has a bug that will lead to game crashes 的提示（跟着一串 ID）。
打开 FiveM 配置文件：%localappdata%\FiveM\FiveM.app\CitizenFX.ini（自定义安装位置则在对应 FiveM.app 里，如 D:\FiveM_Legacy\FiveM.app\CitizenFX.ini）。
把控制台里显示的那一整行（包括你自己的 ID）复制到文件最下面，格式如下。注意：ID 每台电脑不同，不要照抄示例。
保存文件并重启 FiveM，ReShade 即可正常加载（出现编译条、按 Home 有反应）。
en: Press F8 in-game to open the FiveM console.
Look for a line like [Addons] ReShade5=ID:xxxxxxx acknowledged that ReShade 5.x has a bug that will lead to game crashes (followed by an ID).
Open the FiveM config file: %localappdata%\FiveM\FiveM.app\CitizenFX.ini (for custom installs it is in the matching FiveM.app, e.g. D:\FiveM_Legacy\FiveM.app\CitizenFX.ini).
Copy the whole line shown in the console (with your own ID) to the very bottom of the file, as formatted below. The ID is unique per PC — do not copy the example.
Save and restart FiveM. ReShade should now load normally (compilation bar appears, Home works).

body.code:
[Addons]
ReShade5=ID:xxxxxxxxxxxx acknowledged that ReShade 5.x has a bug that will lead to game crashes

note.zh: 这两行必须放在 CitizenFX.ini 的最下面（[Addons] 段）。示例中的 ID:xxxxxxxxxxxx 只是格式示范，请替换成 F8 控制台里显示的你自己的 ID。
note.en: These two lines must go at the very bottom of CitizenFX.ini (the [Addons] section). The ID:xxxxxxxxxxxx in the example is only a format sample — replace it with the ID shown in your F8 console.

zh.q: 游戏打不开 / 闪退怎么办？
zh.a: 删除 FiveM.app 内的 caches 文件夹后重新启动；若仍不行，删除刚复制的画质包文件，逐个排除。
在 ReShade 面板中减少开启的特效数量（尤其是模糊、光线类特效），或把预设强度调低。

zh.q: 按 Home 键没有反应？
zh.a: 确认 dxgi.dll、ReShade.ini 与预设 .ini 都在 FiveM.app\plugins，并按上方进阶章节完成 CitizenFX.ini 放行（F8 控制台 + [Addons] 段）。

zh.q: 进服务器被踢出怎么办？
zh.a: 部分服务器禁止 ReShade / 画质包。进入此类服务器前请先在 ReShade 中点击 Disable 或删除 dxgi.dll。

zh.q: 为什么这个页面内容会实时更新？
zh.a: 本页正文与媒体都通过 GitHub 动态加载（assets/content.json）。仓库内容更新后，刷新页面即可看到新内容，无需重新下载 HTML 文件。

zh.q: ReShade 装好却没编译条、按 Home 没反应？
zh.a: 游戏内按 F8 打开控制台，查看是否有 [Addons] ReShade5=ID:xxxx acknowledged that ReShade 5.x has a bug that will lead to game crashes 提示；把该行（含你自己的 ID）复制到 %localappdata%\FiveM\FiveM.app\CitizenFX.ini 最下面的 [Addons] 段，保存后重启游戏即可放行 ReShade。

zh.q: 提示 Could not find game executable / 找不到游戏怎么办？
zh.a: 打开 %localappdata%\FiveM\FiveM.app\CitizenFX.ini，把 IVPath= 改成你的 GTA V Legacy 安装目录（如 D:\SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Grand Theft Auto V），保存后重启 FiveM。

zh.q: FiveM 支持 GTA V Enhanced 版吗？
zh.a: 支持。2026 年 7 月 21 日 FiveM 发布了 Enhanced（增强版）客户端（早期访问，独立启动器，与 Legacy（传承版）并行）。但早期访问阶段不稳定、画质模组暂不可用、社区生态尚未成熟，本教程针对传承版，请使用 Legacy 完成安装。

en.a: Delete the caches folder inside FiveM.app and relaunch. If it persists, remove the pack files you copied and test them one by one.
Disable some effects in the ReShade panel (especially blur / light effects), or lower the preset intensity.
Make sure dxgi.dll, ReShade.ini and the preset .ini are all in FiveM.app\plugins, and approve ReShade in CitizenFX.ini (F8 console + [Addons] section) as described in the advanced section above.
Some servers ban ReShade / graphics packs. Click Disable in ReShade or remove dxgi.dll before joining such servers.

en.q: Why does this page update automatically?
en.a: All text and media on this page are loaded dynamically from a GitHub repo (assets/content.json). Update the repo and refresh the page — no need to re-download the HTML file.

en.q: ReShade installed but no compilation bar / Home does nothing?
en.a: Press F8 in-game to open the console and look for [Addons] ReShade5=ID:xxxx acknowledged that ReShade 5.x has a bug that will lead to game crashes. Copy that line (with your own ID) into the [Addons] section at the very bottom of %localappdata%\FiveM\FiveM.app\CitizenFX.ini, save and restart the game.

en.q: Could not find game executable / game not found?
en.a: Open %localappdata%\FiveM\FiveM.app\CitizenFX.ini and point IVPath= to your GTA V Legacy install folder (e.g. D:\SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Grand Theft Auto V), then save and restart FiveM.

en.q: Does FiveM support the GTA V Enhanced build?
en.a: Yes. FiveM for GTAV Enhanced launched as early access on July 21, 2026 (a separate launcher running alongside Legacy). However, early access is unstable, graphic mods are not available yet, and the ecosystem is not mature — this tutorial targets the Legacy build.
